description: Documentation and example code for using SQLite3 with Flask, including connection management, query functions, and schema initialization.

methods.name: get_db
methods.description: Provides a database connection tied to the Flask application context, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the database connection at the end of the application context.

methods.name: make_dicts
methods.description: Converts SQLite query results into dictionaries with column names as keys.

methods.name: query_db
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and fetches results, optionally returning a single record.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database schema from an external SQL file.
